name: ADA MP-1 OD1 drive filter three-way switch mod

mentions.name: ADA MP-1 OD1 drive filter three-way switch mod
mentions.description: A hardware modification that adds a three-way switch, mounted on the side panel of a 1987 ADA MP-1 guitar preamp, to select one of three different center frequencies for the OD1 drive filter when enabled in "tube dist" mode. The treble-boosted "frown curve" setting centered on 3.2 kHz produces a tight, punchy, clearly articulated tone that cuts through well in a mix.
mentions.audience: Personal use in the author's own guitar rig
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the weekend I finished a kind of hardware project: I added a three-way switch to my ADA MP-1 guitar preamp [1987], mounted on the side panel, which selects one of three different center frequencies for the OD1 drive filter (enabled in "tube dist" mode).
